column3: ## Search articles via Discovery API and verify multiple author affiliations

column1: Depends on API : CRUD Articles : Create an article with multiple author affiliations via CRUD API

column3: Send a GET request to /api/search/articles/doi%3A10.1234%2Fapi.multi.affil.01 (or search query for the article title)

column4: Response JSON contains "results" array with the matching article
The article's "bibjson.author" array correctly includes the "affiliations" list for each author
